Perhaps there's a way to create plugin parameter configuration descriptions in the [plugin-input.ts](https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-start-stop/blob/ee4f7c698f0e221381df7c73f56457e1ca4d22ea/src/types/plugin-input.ts) file.
Awesome, thanks, updated the spec
I think tooltip is fine
https://github.com/ubiquity-os/plugin-template/issues/33

Right now all core plugins have a `manifest.json` file ([example](https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-start-stop/blob/ee4f7c698f0e221381df7c73f56457e1ca4d22ea/manifest.json)) describing plugin's: - name - description - listeners - command examples - configuration parameters The issue is that when plugin configuration is displayed in https://github.com/ubiquity-os/ubiquity-os-plugin-installer there're no any configuration parameter descriptions so it's really hard for a partner to find out what parameters are meant to be used for: What should be done for all of the core plugins in https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace: 1. Make sure the readme file is relevant (i.e. has a relevant config example and configuration parameter descriptions) 2. Make sure there's a `name` property in the `manifest.json` (some of the core plugins miss it) 3. Make sure there's a `description` property in the `manifest.json` 4. Add descriptions of plugin configuration parameters in the `plugin-input.ts` file (for example [this](https://github.com/Meniole/command-query-user/blob/042533ebbbfebaf5f5754b1d4a2fcf1d8afd94ad/src/types/plugin-input.ts#L7) code generates [this](https://github.com/Meniole/command-query-user/blob/ecb3c906d0e21b1557b23a8465fb2760b3f87abf/manifest.json#L16) manifest). Simply put we should add the `description` field for all of the plugin parameters in the `plugin-input.ts` file. Description should include general info and possible parameter options. Notice that in the `manifest.json` file the `configuration` schema is created dynamically: 1. [update-configuration.yml](https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-start-stop/blob/ee4f7c698f0e221381df7c73f56457e1ca4d22ea/.github/workflows/update-configuration.yml) workflow runs 2. Configuration schema is fetched from [plugin-input.ts](https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-start-stop/blob/ee4f7c698f0e221381df7c73f56457e1ca4d22ea/src/types/plugin-input.ts) 3. [manifest.json](https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-start-stop/blob/ee4f7c698f0e221381df7c73f56457e1ca4d22ea/manifest.json) is updated ([example commit](https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-start-stop/commit/56232c8c67d198cc46cf61c9b3fd0b90cce57df7)) Then we'll display all configuration parameter descriptions in https://github.com/ubiquity-os/ubiquity-os-plugin-installer on creating/editing a config. Update: parameter description PRs: - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/text-vector-embeddings/pull/49 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/daemon-pricing/pull/56 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-start-stop/pull/94 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/daemon-disqualifier/pull/52 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-wallet/pull/24 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-query/pull/25 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/command-ask/pull/41 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/text-conversation-rewards/pull/202 - https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/daemon-merging/pull/30
